constraints: References to lists are exported by name instead of a JSON pointer into lists.json; references to named filters/display formats (the '|' prefix) are exported by value instead of a pointer into filters.json.

Pictures from the picture library are not exported: converted objects keep referencing the library via a special "pictlib:xx" icon URL; static pictures are converted as picture-type object properties.
Deprecated objects and unsupported object/properties are ignored during conversion.
For a table form, pass the form's table in aTable and the form name in formName; for a project form, omit aTable and pass the form name directly.
The resulting object is intended to be passed directly to the DIALOG command to run the form.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Converts a classic (binary, structure-file-stored) form into a dynamic form object, applying documented reference/export rules so the result can be run directly via DIALOG.
